metaDescription: White-label WordPress website for Big Voodoo, a law firm marketing agency: service menus, an AI readiness assessment page, insights and a contact form.
summary: WordPress website for a digital marketing agency that works with law firms.
overview: Big Voodoo is a digital marketing agency that describes itself as focused entirely on law firms, offering websites, SEO, pay-per-click and social campaigns. Pixel2Tech built Big Voodoo's WordPress website as white-label development partner for a digital agency. The site presents the agency's services to attorneys and turns that interest into calls and contact requests.
challenge: The agency offers a long list of services, from website builds and site management to search, paid ads, social and AI search readiness, and each one needs a place without crowding the home page. Law firm partners scanning the site also need a phone number and a way to get in touch from any point on the page.
approach: A light header carries Services and Insights dropdowns, Our Team and Let's Talk, while the hero pairs a large red headline with the phone number and a Get Started Today button. The home page moves through the agency's pitch, a dark call-out card linking to a free AI readiness assessment, the agency's own stat circles, four service rows with contact buttons, testimonials, a team section and the latest articles. A Gravity Forms contact form and footer with the office address close every page.
outcome: A WordPress website where attorneys can scan the agency's services, try the AI readiness assessment, read its articles and reach the team by phone or form. The block-based layout lets the agency add service and insight pages without new templates.

process.title: Navigation
process.body: The Services menu lists website solutions, digital marketing, custom AI workflows, social campaigns, AI integrations, site management and AI readiness, while Insights groups the blog with GEO and AEO topics.

process.title: Home page
process.body: Sections run from the red headline hero to the agency's pitch, an assessment card, service rows with bullet lists, client quotes, a team introduction and three recent articles.

process.title: Lead capture
process.body: The phone number sits in the hero, Get Started Today and Contact Us buttons repeat down the page, and a Gravity Forms form asks for company, name, phone, email and comments.

process.title: Mobile
process.body: On phones the menu collapses to a single icon and the headline, phone number and Get Started Today button stack in the first screen.

whyItMatters: Law firms compare agencies quickly and want to talk to someone fast. A site that keeps the phone number, assessment and contact form close at hand gives a busy attorney an easy next step.

faqs.q: What is the Big Voodoo website built with?
faqs.a: It runs on WordPress with a custom block theme built on the Gutenberg editor, and Gravity Forms handles the contact form.

faqs.q: Do you work white-label for agencies?
faqs.a: Yes. We build websites and Shopify stores under the agency's brand, with an NDA when needed. Tell us about the project and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
